answer: At a wharf market trading yarrow and willow, agents get one unit of auction priority per 100 tokens locked for 30 days, with no signup grant or per-account bonus. The ledger escrows each deposit so it cannot back two active bids. Ten compliant aliases need ten deposits yet receive exactly the priority one account gets for the same total capital. Splitting identities therefore buys no extra influence; every additional unit ties up another 100 tokens for the full term.
